description: Some recipients have temporary forwarding, split offices, remote schedules, or special delivery instructions that are easy to misremember and keep causing misrouted mail. All organizations and people are fictional.

user_profile.persona: 34-year-old internal distribution coordinator responsible for nonstandard delivery rules
user_profile.context: The normal routing works fine, but exception handling is generating repeated avoidable mistakes
user_profile.communication_style: Exception-oriented and practical, wants recipient-specific rules kept current and easy to scan

fact_sheet.fact: Dr. Aris Thorne is a Senior Researcher in the Quantum Dynamics Lab, located in Building C, workstation C3-21.
Lena Petrova is the Head of Global Partnerships, and her employee ID is 'LPetrova78'.
The 'Project Nightingale' team is a temporary working group; their mail stop code is 'PN-TEMP'.
From May 1, 2024, to August 31, 2024, all mail for Dr. Aris Thorne must be forwarded to the Zenith Labs Annex at 1850 Innovation Drive.
Jia Li, a new contractor, has all mail held in central mailroom bin #112 until her badge access is approved, expected by June 15, 2024.
All mail for the 'Summer Internship Program' must be delivered to the Galileo Conference Center, Room G-7, from June 1, 2024, to August 15, 2024.
Lena Petrova works at the main campus (400 Solstice Avenue) on Mondays and Tuesdays.
Lena Petrova works at the downtown office (1200 Commerce Plaza, Suite 900) on Thursdays and Fridays.
To determine Lena Petrova's location on Wednesdays, check her public calendar on Outlook before the 9:00 AM mail run.
Mail addressed generically to the 'Legal Department' without a specific recipient name must be delivered to Kenji Tanaka at the 400 Solstice Avenue campus, Building B, Floor 4.
Marco Diaz (Engineering, Desk 4B-113) works remotely on Mondays and Fridays; his mail should be held and delivered on Tuesday mornings.
The entire Marketing department (Building D, Floor 2) works remotely on Fridays, so all Friday mail for them goes into departmental bin 'D-MKTG' for Monday delivery.
Dr. Evelyn Reed (R&D) is a fully remote employee; all her physical mail must be scanned and emailed to ereed@fictionalcorp.net by 4:00 PM daily.
All packages for the 'Quantum Dynamics Lab' require a signature from either Dr. Aris Thorne or his lab manager, Ben Carter.
Mail marked 'CONFIDENTIAL - BOARD OF DIRECTORS' must be hand-delivered directly to the CEO's executive assistant, Maria Flores, at workstation A-101.
All subscription magazines for the employee lounge should be delivered to the reception desk in Building A, not to a departmental mail stop.
Paychecks distributed internally are to be placed in a locked bin (Bin #L-01) for HR pickup at 11:00 AM on the last business Thursday of the month.
Any mail from the 'Federal Patent Office' must be time-stamped upon arrival and delivered to Kenji Tanaka in Legal within 1 hour.
The master list of delivery exceptions is a SharePoint list named 'Mailroom Special Handling'.
The URL for the 'Mailroom Special Handling' list is https://fictionalcorp.sharepoint.com/sites/mailroom/specialhandling.
A daily 'Exception Briefing' report is printed from the SharePoint list at 7:30 AM and posted on the main sorting station whiteboard.
Misrouted mail must be logged in the 'Misdelivery Log' Google Sheet before it is rerouted to the correct recipient.
The barcode scanner for logging secure packages is a Zebra DS2208, serial number ZB4-99812.
The Office Manager, Sarah Chen, is responsible for updating the SharePoint list and can be reached at extension 5250.
For questions about forwarding for R&D personnel, contact lab manager Ben Carter at extension 4511.
To verify an employee's current office location, use the internal directory tool 'PeopleFinder' at http://intranet/find.
The direct line for the mailroom supervisor, David Rodriguez, is 555-0199, extension 4500.
Urgent delivery issues after 5:00 PM should be reported to Campus Security at extension 2222.
The mail drop-off slot for the Engineering department is located next to conference room 4B-100 in Building B.
The central mailroom is located in Building A, Room G-05, and is open from 7:00 AM to 5:30 PM.
Mail for the 'CFO Office' should be delivered to Sam Jones at workstation A-105, not the CEO's assistant.

user_needs.description: What is the temporary forwarding address and effective date range for Dr. Aris Thorne?
What are Lena Petrova's work locations on Mondays, Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Fridays?
How do I determine Lena Petrova's work location on Wednesdays?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: This is a direct follow-up to the previous question about Lena Petrova's schedule.

user_needs.description: What is the special delivery instruction for mail marked 'CONFIDENTIAL - BOARD OF DIRECTORS'?
What is another high-priority mail category with a time-sensitive delivery rule, and what is that rule?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: After asking about one type of high-priority mail, the user may naturally ask for another time-sensitive exception category and its handling rule.

user_needs.description: What is the mail handling procedure for Marco Diaz, who works remotely on certain days?
What is the process for handling mail for the entire Marketing department on Fridays when they work remotely?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: After handling a rule for an individual remote worker, it's natural to ask about rules for a remote department.

user_needs.description: If a package is still sent to the Quantum Dynamics Lab during Dr. Aris Thorne's forwarding period, whose signature can be used to accept it?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After checking Dr. Thorne's forwarding setup, a direct follow-up is how a package sent to his lab can still be accepted there.

user_needs.description: Where is the master list of mailroom exceptions stored and who is responsible for updating it?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After dealing with a multi-part, complex rule like Lena Petrova's, the user may want to know where the official documentation for all such rules is kept and who maintains it.

user_needs.description: How should I handle physical mail for Dr. Evelyn Reed, who is a fully remote employee?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After discussing rules for partially remote employees and departments, the next logical exception to consider is the handling for a fully remote employee.

user_needs.description: Who is the contact person for questions about forwarding for R&D personnel?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After learning about a special handling rule for an R&D lab, the user might want to know who the general contact is for that division's mail issues.
